name: video-built-in-pipelines

scripts.lint: npm run lint:pipeline -- pipelines/narrated-illustrated-video.yaml pipelines/fairy-tale-adaptation.yaml pipelines/repository-documentation.yaml fixtures/valid/pipeline-basic.yaml && npm run lint:skill -- fixtures/valid/skill-basic.yaml
